claims.claim: The actual mode projection has the displayed Volterra equation with residual O(epsilon^5(1+t)^3), and the residual-free predictor has error O(epsilon^5(1+t)^4) on epsilon^2(1+T)^3<=kappa.
For F=Kf^2, the exact shape coefficient, continuum transform, moments, static susceptibility1/70 and precise old-Gamma normalization are computed.

The continuum tail is sin(2t+3pi/4)/(16sqrt(pi)t^(3/2))+O(t^(-5/2)); it is L1 but has divergent first absolute moment. Full memory retains a nondecaying shape piece and has no exact finite constant-matrix linear realization.
The velocity-response transfer is positive-real. Actual zero homogeneous initial field yields no independent random forcing; neither a noise law nor long-time Markov damping is derived.
